bugs.title: Reset progress without a page reload does not bring back How to play, the chapter card or the 'new friend' cards
bugs.where: Options > Reset progress, then Chat and Outcome, level_01
steps: Fresh browser. Start, open Level 1, close the chapter card and the 3 How to play steps, pick Noodle Nook: Outcome shows 'A NEW FRIEND HAS JOINED!' (Liam)
Go back to the map, Options > Reset progress > Reset (do not reload the page)
bugs.expected: As the Reset check promises ('shows How to play and the chapter cards again'): the Chapter 1 card and How to play open before the chat, and the Outcome welcomes Liam again with the new-friend card
bugs.actual: The chat starts straight away with no chapter card and no How to play, and the Outcome shows only the Scrapbook card, no new-friend card. Storage is cleared correctly, but chapterIntro.js, howToPlay.js and friendsAnnounced.js keep their in-memory 'memory' fallback, which resetProgress() never clears, and load() falls back to it when the key is missing. Side effect: because those popups were never marked seen again, they all pop up after the next page reload instead. After Reset + reload everything shows correctly.

setup.settings: defaults (run_3 also with Text size Large, Chat pace Relaxed)

bugs.title: Turning music off with the HUD speaker leaves the Options Music row on 'On', and clicking 'On' then does nothing
bugs.where: Options screen with the HUD music panel (bottom-left speaker)
steps: Map > Options (music playing, Music row shows On)
Press M (or click the speaker) and click the ON/OFF pill so it reads OFF; close the panel
Look at the Music row, then click its 'On' button
bugs.expected: The Music row switches to Off as soon as the HUD turns music off; clicking On turns the music back on
bugs.actual: The row still highlights On although music is off and saved as 'off'. Clicking On does nothing (the click handler ignores the already-highlighted choice), so the player has to click Off and then On, or use the HUD again. Leaving and re-entering Options fixes the display.

bugs.title: Key presses that land in the same frame are replayed several times (Options changes the wrong setting)
bugs.where: Options (also seen on the level map); likely every screen
steps: Map > Options, focus on Text size
Press ArrowDown 6 times very quickly (less than about 16 ms apart, e.g. rolling or mashing keys)
Or press ArrowUp then ArrowRight in quick succession
bugs.expected: 6 Downs bring the focus back to the same row; Up then Right changes Sound effects
bugs.actual: 6 browser keydowns produced 41 Phaser keydown events and the focus ended on another row; Up+Right moved the focus to High contrast and switched it On (4 of 4 trials). On the map, 2 quick Right presses gave 3 keydown events. With 20 ms or more between presses everything is correct. Possibly a Phaser 3.90 keyboard-queue quirk rather than game code, and only reachable with very fast presses, but it changes settings the player didn't choose.
bugs.frequency: every time when presses are under one frame apart (4 of 4 trials + 2 other runs); never with 20 ms+ gaps

setup.settings: defaults; headless Chrome via Playwright at about 50 fps

bugs.title: An empty saved music volume is read as 0%, so the game is silently muted instead of using the default
bugs.where: Boot / HUD music panel, any screen
steps: Set localStorage 'lets-eat-music-volume-v1' to an empty string, reload
Start, wait for the music; press M
bugs.expected: Like 'abc', '-5' or '2', an unusable value falls back to the default 25%
bugs.actual: Music plays at volume 0, the HUD shows 0%, and every sound effect is suppressed (sfx skip at volume 0). Number('') is 0, so readVolume() accepts it.

setup.settings: music volume key corrupted by hand

not_bugs: Every Options value survives a reload; Reset progress keeps lets-eat-settings-v1 byte for byte
Garbage or broken JSON in lets-eat-settings-v1 never crashes: unknown values fall back to defaults, valid ones are kept
Music Off and Sound effects Off are independent; switching Sound effects On plays one preview click
The click that seemed doubled in soundsPlaying (one at volume 1.00, one at 0.25) is a single sound.play call; WebAudio reports the gain before it applies
At volume 0 music keeps 'playing' at volume 0 (silent) and no sound effect is started: silent as required

Options cannot be opened from inside a level (only from the map); the HUD panel there only has music volume and on/off. Chat pace was therefore tested between levels; a new pace applies at the next level without a reload
Animations Off: zero running tweens on every screen tested; typing dots stay still and faint, which is expected
High contrast changes panels, text and the chat backdrop; the map and its LOCKED badges look the same as normal mode (dimmed on purpose)
Options remembers the focused row when you leave and come back (scene data carried over); harmless
layoutProblems hits on Chat and Results with Large text are scrolled or masked lines, not real overflow; long reviews scroll with '↓ scroll for more'
Outcome after a perfect pick has no 'Back to levels' button (Next level → instead); by design per OutcomeScene
feedback: Music lives in two places (HUD panel and Options row) that don't talk to each other while both are on screen, and the HUD slider is labelled MUSIC VOLUME but also sets the sound effects volume, which surprised me.
